t: Write autosave checkpoint before each track append so crash recovery has a known-good restore point
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Step 8 (track capture instructions) — how track.jsonl is appended each turn. 2. Check if WAI-Spoke/sessions/{session}/.autosave/ pattern exists anywhere. 3. Read WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json to see if autosave fields exist.
execute: 1. Add to wai.md track capture instructions: before appending to track.jsonl, write current turn's JSON to {session_dir}/.autosave/turn-{N}.json. 2. Keep only last 3 checkpoints (delete turn-{N-3}.json after writing turn-{N}.json). 3. Add .autosave/ to the session directory structure documentation. 4. Sync wai.md to all targets.
verify: 1. After 4 turns, ls {session_dir}/.autosave/ shows exactly 3 files (turn-2, turn-3, turn-4). 2. Each checkpoint is valid JSON matching the track entry schema. 3. If track.jsonl is corrupted, checkpoints provide recovery data.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Per-turn autosave checkpoints for crash recovery — write before track append, keep rolling window of 3
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not implementing the recovery UI — just the checkpoint mechanism. Recovery is task-track-interruption-detection + /wai-green-light.
